question: In a certain code language, ‘BUSHY’ is written as ‘CTTGZ’ and ‘COAST’ is written as ‘DNBRU’. How will ‘DWELL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/798d760c9bb8ecd2c7b542a134f9d5d81881e5ec699de0f40f1ed3a1b2ccc0a8.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BUSHY’ is written as ‘CTTGZ’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca47469d3815a62fcf1954ca9b63104a8401b68c7ae19709fe85a1ffd287f302.png] 

‘COAST’ is written as ‘DNBRU’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/417bb5fb5843f91fed7f8264dc2706b2e11e89f404933b206b095de41ba11b9c.png] 

Similarly, ‘**DWELL**’ be written :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdd65734c39dc7d08d3a1c2e70d337095c3317cf936f33bca2c8a6505c609bb7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
